probeEvidence.notes: Drove all five edge states via window.__setCameraEdge (no lab rail mounted), plus capture, video record/stop, grid, countdown, long-press sheet, and a 2x text-scale pass. Zero console/page errors everywhere. Confirmed by geometry probe: .strip-wrap bottom = 812.5px vs stage bottom = 755px => 57.5px clipped (overflow:hidden on .cam-viewport), visible as a hard-cut thumbnail row in every rest frame. Confirmed phantom state: photo-mode 3s countdown capture leaves '00:01 REC · 12 MP' timer pill painted at top of viewfinder indefinitely after the capture (startCountdownThenCapture adds vfTimer.on at index.html:940 and nothing clears it on the photo path). Reduced-motion pass: 0 infinite animations, content present. No lab rail: critic had to use dev globals.

blind.A: visionOS design language: iOS 17 Camera rest state (the camera surface Apple actually ships on this design language)
blind.B: Horizon OS: Quest 3 system camera-permission dialog + passthrough safety pill

blindDescriptions.A: Full-bleed live viewfinder IS the surface; chrome is four floating elements: white shutter ring bottom-center, mode strip (PHOTO/VIDEO/PORTRAIT, yellow-highlighted), last-shot thumbnail bottom-left, and a top chevron that expands one row of icon controls on demand only. Nothing else is ever painted over the world. Capture feedback is a shutter blip plus the thumbnail swapping. Permission-denied is a single centered card over the frozen last frame with one Settings deep-link.
blindDescriptions.B: A near-opaque dark rounded panel floating in room space: large title, body copy, two buttons (Deny / Allow) with the controller-laser focus ring unambiguous on one at a time. Camera state surfaces as a small passthrough pill, not a full surface. Loading is a bare centered spinner in a panel; errors are a generic 'Something went wrong' panel with Try Again. Honest but heavy, and text-dense for arm's-length reading.
blindDescriptions.C: A 600x600 simulated viewfinder card (gradient world, glass chips top-left countdown/aspect, top-right grid/flash, EXIF pills bottom) over a dark scrim, mode tab strip below, 72px white shutter with label, last-capture thumb + meta, and a recents strip that is clipped mid-thumbnail by the stage's bottom edge. Five edge states are designed (empty/loading/error/offline/permission) with distinct icons, actions, and recovery flows. Capture chain: 220ms flash, shutter ring pulse, thumbnail pop, confirmation banner. Recording turns the shutter red and shows a REC timer. Countdown pops large tabular numerals.

referenceScreens.visionOS: iOS 17 Camera app rest state (Apple's camera surface in the visionOS design language): edge-to-edge live viewfinder, one white ring shutter bottom center, horizontally scrollable mode strip with the active mode in yellow caps, last-shot thumbnail bottom-left, all other controls collapsed behind a top chevron. At arm's length you extract 'camera, photo mode, press here' in well under a second because the world is the content and chrome is four items.
referenceScreens.horizonOS: Quest 3 Horizon OS system permission dialog for camera access: a floating near-opaque dark panel with a bold white title ('Allow ... to access your camera?'), grey body text, and Deny/Allow buttons where the laser-pointer hover paints an unmistakable highlight on exactly one button; the OS additionally shows a small passthrough status pill. Loading in these panels is a bare spinner; errors are a generic panel with Try Again. Text is larger than Apple's but panels read as slabs, not glass.

biggestGap: Recents strip clipped at stage bottom · components/07-camera/index.html:58-66 (.cam-viewport inset + overflow:hidden) and :69-72 (.vf-card fixed 338px) · expected the Recents strip fully inside the 600px stage (or an intentional scroll affordance), got 57.5px of overflow with thumbnails sliced mid-body by overflow:hidden in every rest frame (strip-wrap bottom 812.5px vs stage bottom 755px) — the resting surface reads as broken rendering. Runner-up defect, same fix pass: photo-mode countdown leaves a phantom '00:01 REC · 12 MP' pill painted forever (vfTimer.classList.add('on') at index.html:940 never cleared on the photo path).
reason: Ours loses to the visionOS-design-language camera on 8 of 9 criteria. The core loop (viewfinder, shutter, capture chain, five designed edge states, zero console errors, reduced-motion honored) is genuinely strong and beats Horizon OS's slab panels overall — edge states is a fair outright win. But the resting frame of a camera surface ships with a clipped thumbnail row (57.5px overflow, confirmed by geometry), a photo-mode countdown leaves a false REC timer on screen indefinitely, the context sheet renders a literal 'stub' pill and 'clipboard stub'/'demo · stub' banner copy to the wearer, the offline card claims 'shutter still works' while viewport pointer-events:none disables the shutter button, and all type is px-locked so 2x text scale changes nothing. Not first overall, multiple named gaps: fail.
passCondition: Ours ranked second of three (60 vs visionOS 76). Gaps remain: clipped Recents strip, phantom REC timer after countdown, 'stub' engineering copy on screen, offline copy/behavior contradiction, no text-scale reflow.
